_help: Manual corrections applied on top of OpenAlex. DOIs are bare and lower-case (e.g. 10.1111/acer.15503). 'hide': DOIs to drop. 'co_first': DOIs where you are co-first author (adds a dagger). 'links': extra buttons per DOI, e.g. code or data. 'extra': publications OpenAlex is missing, using the same fields as data/publications.json.
